questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You are approaching an intersection. Watch carefully for other traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you see this sign. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must always let trains pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before you go down the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You are approaching a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services ahead. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You are in or approaching a school zone. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A lane is ending ahead. Be ready to merge safely into other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to be careful when roads are wet. Wet pavement is slippery and harder to drive on safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Be ready to slow down if you see this hand signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is coming. Never try to race a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm upward, they are signaling that they will turn right. Be ready to adjust your driving if you see this hand signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then left. Slow down and be ready to turn safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means you must stop completely. Look both ways and yield to other traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs with yellow and black markings only warn about railroad crossings ahead. Be prepared to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that construction or road work is coming up. Stay alert for workers, equipment, and temporary traffic controls.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first. Only enter when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right side of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely over the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. Keep to the right of the divider.
